''See also: [[Witnesses Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Witnesses are members of the [[Guild of Witnesses]], an organization responsible for maintaining and distributing accurate historical records. They serve as impartial verifiers of truth; any story or claim made within [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]] can be confirmed or refuted by their testimony. Because of this role, they are essential for documenting significant events, such as the appointment of an [[Imperial]] heir, and providing notarized proof regarding the authenticity of individuals or equipment. Witnesses typically operate in pairs consisting of a [[Chronicler]] and a [[Silent One]]. The [[Chronicler]] is tasked with memorizing and transcribing information, often identified by a belt of wax candles worn at the waist. [[Silent One{{!}}The Silent One]] is responsible for protecting the [[Chronicler]] and is characterized by a covered mouth and various weapons. [[The Guild]] is led by two heads, the [[Farstrider sisters]], who are noted for their ability to perform both roles interchangeably. While the [[Guild]] is technically considered property of its own organization, Witnesses are known to travel extensively across the world. Although they strive for unvarnished truth, their reports are often subject to political manipulation by others after the fact.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A pair of members from the Witnesses, one of the [[Imperial Guilds]], approached [[Calder]] with a request to travel to an island to retrieve a relic. During their interactions with [[Calder]] and [[Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel]], the group maintained a tight grip on their weapons, though they appeared to be tired. This group has previously worked alongside the [[Blackwatch]] and possesses the ability to relive recorded memories by burning specific candles. Their status is further evidenced by the fact that [[Guards]] serve them.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Witnesses serve as a group under the employment of [[Naberius Clayborn]]. Within this organization, members are discouraged from forming personal relationships by the [[Guild]]. During an interrogation, [[Zhen of the Masons{{!}}Zhen]] instructed a prisoner to reserve his biography for the group's attention. On one occasion, two Witnesses were present at a single event, though [[Shera]] has a history of killing members of the organization.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Witnesses]] is a group that [[Naberius Clayborn]] works for.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Zhen of the Masons{{!}}Zhen]] told the prisoner to save his biography for the [[Witnesses]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Shera]] has killed [[Witnesses]] before.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[The Guild]] discourages relationships between [[Witnesses]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|There were two [[Witnesses]] present.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c10">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Witnesses serve as investigative tools capable of verifying or denying the accuracy of various news reports. Within the Palace, a pair of these entities is stationed at a dungeon checkpoint. Their influence extends to public discourse, as seen when they published an article exonerating the [[Imperialist Guilds]] for attacks carried out in the name of justice. Additionally, they are responsible for issuing the official public declaration regarding the dissolution of the [[Champions]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Witnesses]] can be used to investigate news reports.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Witnesses]] can verify or deny any story put out.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Palace dungeon]] checkpoint includes a pair of [[Witnesses]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Witnesses]] published an article exonerating the [[Imperialist Guilds]] for attacks conducted in pursuit of justice.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Witnesses]] are responsible for issuing the public declaration of the [[Champions]]' dissolution.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Witnesses are a guild dedicated to speaking the unvarnished truth and serving as neutral arbitrators. Operating in pairs composed of a [[Chronicler]] and a [[Silent One]], these individuals possess the ability to collaborate on constructing boxes used to seal [[Vessels]]. During the events in the tower, both sets of Witnesses remained alive and provided reports regarding the deaths of [[Guild Heads]]. As a source of hope following recent events, the twin Witnesses were specifically identified by [[Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius]] as one of the [[Guild Heads]] who should be spared from assassination.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Witnesses]] act as neutral arbitrators.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Witnesses]] can collaborate on creating boxes to seal [[Vessels]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Witnesses]] work in pairs consisting of a [[Chronicler]] and a [[Silent One]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Both sets of [[Witnesses]] were still alive in the tower.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Witnesses]] report on the deaths of [[Guild Heads]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Witnesses]] are the hope from the events of today.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Witnesses]] are a guild that speaks the unvarnished truth.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The twin [[Witnesses]] are one of the [[Guild Heads]] [[Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius]] suggests should not be assassinated.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
